known_caveats: Annual EOD historical occurrence evidence only, with source-specific original-field and independent method review. No checklist non-detection, absence, establishment, current persistence or individual human expert-approval inference.
source_warnings: Historical 2024 recorded occurrence only; no current persistence, breeding, establishment, abundance or invasive-impact claim.

The parent public search is incomplete:15000 records retained of21878 declared. No source silence, failed request, rejected record or incomplete scope supports absence, non-detection or completed no-evidence research.

scope_complete on positive outcomes refers only to the explicit finite original-record set listed in the pinned method and query URLs. It does not claim exhaustive national source acquisition or county protocol completion.

Only97 selected originals in the51 approved county pairs have independent original-field approval in this method. Other retained interpreted records and26 deferred county pairs are not silently approved.

Original county/state names resolve uniquely to active counties; coordinates and GADM are retained context, not county assignment authority. Missing coordinate uncertainty alone does not defeat an explicit original county.
The explicit collection allowlist is EBIRD, EBIRD_ATL_NY and EBIRD_ATL_NC. Original and interpreted collection codes, catalog numbers and full occurrence URNs must match without rewriting the source.

Cornell pages describe New York and North Carolina eBird atlas portals. Interpreting the corresponding internal collection codes as portal identities is qualified; the pages do not define the GBIF collection-code mapping, and atlas participation does not establish breeding or expert review.
Opaque not_reviewed and crawler fields match retained dataset annotations; metadata propagation is qualified inference, not individual rejection or individual human expert approval.
Home, park, cemetery, golf-course or zoo locality words alone do not establish captivity. Specific source-record contradictions and negated captivity instructions are reviewed in context.
Distinct occurrence identifiers may share observers, birds or events; selected counts are not summed as independent animals.
The initial partial search timeout, bounded resume stop and failed Cornell block-page context request remain preserved. No failure is rewritten as a successful acquisition.

Two partial search acquisitions containing50 retained pages,141 selected original responses and their distinct executed code identities remain retained across shared archives; only declared selected originals are used as positive witnesses.
